provenance_caveat: Real Hyperliquid (Ironflow node-derived, native) data, non-synthetic; node-derived (Ironflow HF, CC BY 4.0), NOT the venue's own candleSnapshot; Hyperliquid-native evidence (not cross-venue).
method: Full-portfolio placebo: every 17-of-33 gate-passing crash-rebound event subset is run through the real portfolio engine with all other signals masked. The memoized generate_signal is exact and reproduces the canonical campaign to the cent.

per_event_null_reconciliation.why_not_comparable: Per-event sims size each trade at 1.25% of 24h volume with no portfolio gross cap (desired notionals up to $7.29M); the canonical portfolio caps gross at $120k and admits only 8 concurrent/sequential positions. The per-event null therefore measures uncapped single-trade sizing, not the portfolio admission/cap/occupancy process.

limitations: Conditions on the observed 33 signal-gate events and 17 canonical trades; it tests admission/cap/occupancy selection, not the temporal crash-rebound edge versus random event times.
Only 5 traded symbols and 33 gate-passing events remain; the placebo cannot create statistical power that the sample does not contain.
Memoized generate_signal is exact for the run config/data (verified by exact canonical replay) but is not a general accelerator for other configs.
